name: Deptweet_rehydrate
description: Code and data supporting the paper on confidence-stratified evaluation of depression-severity classification (DEPTWEET and DepSeverity). This repository contains: Experiments.ipynb: the full experimental pipeline (data preparation, DistilBERT and TF-IDF + Logistic Regression models, confidence-stratified error analysis, clean-train/dirty-test design, PHQ-9 keyword-dependence check, and the DepSeverity-Dreaddit alignment). Deptweet_rehydrate.csv: the list of DEPTWEET tweet IDs recovered in September 2026 (N = 3,359), with confidence scores and severity labels. Tweet text is not redistributed, in line with the source platform's developer terms. Depseverity.csv: the cleaned DepSeverity dataset (N = 3,434) with confidence scores inherited from Dreaddit. Original datasets: DEPTWEET (Kabir et al., 2023), DepSeverity, and Dreaddit (Turcan & McKeown, 2019). Please cite the original sources when reusing the data.
